welcome.title: Welcome to MaryClean!
welcome.content: This quick tour will walk you through the most important sections of this screen. Press Next to get started.

sidebar.title: Main Menu
sidebar.content: Use this sidebar to easily navigate through all sections of the system.

stats.title: Daily Summary
stats.content: These 4 cards show real-time data: orders received today, orders in progress, orders ready for pickup, and today's total income.

widgets.title: Quick Insights
widgets.content: Here you can see your most frequent customers, the most requested services, and urgent deliveries that need priority attention.

widgetClientes.title: Top Customers 🏆
widgetClientes.content: Shows the ranking of your best customers for the selected period. You can filter by date range. #1 is the customer who has spent the most at your laundry.

widgetServicios.title: Top Requested Services ⭐
widgetServicios.content: Shows which type of service (simple wash, ironing, etc.) has the most demand. Great for knowing what to specialize in or promote.

widgetEntregas.title: Urgent Deliveries ⚠️
widgetEntregas.content: Lists the oldest active orders that haven't been delivered yet. If an order has been sitting for days, it will appear here highlighted so you can take action.

welcome.title: Register a New Order
welcome.content: Follow the 3 steps on this screen to correctly enter an order. I'll explain each one.

cliente.title: Step 1: Identify the Customer 👤
cliente.content: Type the customer's ID or document number. The system will find them automatically. If they're new, a form will appear to register their information.

prendas.title: Step 2: Add Garments 👕
prendas.content: Select the garment type and service from the catalog, then press "Add". You can change the quantity directly in the table (decimals supported for kg).

pago.title: Step 3: Initial Payment (Optional) 💵
pago.content: If the customer wants to leave a deposit, enable this option, enter the amount and payment method. If not, leave it disabled and collect payment at the end.

acciones.title: Save the Order
acciones.content: Once the customer is selected and the garments are added, press 'Register Order' to save it and issue the ticket. You can also cancel if you made a mistake.

welcome.title: Orders Management
welcome.content: Here you'll see all active orders in the system. You can search, filter, and manage each one.

busqueda.title: Smart Search 🔍
busqueda.content: Type the customer name, their ID, or the ticket code to instantly find any order.

filtro.title: Filter by Status 🗳️
filtro.content: Use this selector to view only orders in a specific status: Received, In Process, Ready, Delivered, or Cancelled. Very useful for focusing on what needs attention right now.

actualizar.title: Refresh List 🔄
actualizar.content: Press this button to manually reload the order list and see the latest changes without refreshing the entire page.

tabla.title: Orders Table 📊
tabla.content: Each row is an order with its status, total, and date. Scroll to the Actions column to interact with each one.

acciones.title: Actions
acciones.cobrar: Opens the payment modal where you can register a full payment or partial deposit, choose the method (Cash, Card, or Yape) and print the receipt.
acciones.verDetalle: Opens the full order detail: garments entered, client information, total amount, and the option to change the status (Received → Ready → Delivered).

welcome.title: Customer Management
welcome.content: All customers are automatically saved here when you register an order. You can search, view their order history, or update their data.

busqueda.title: Quick Search
busqueda.content: Find any customer by typing their name, ID, or phone number. The table will filter automatically as you type.

agregar.title: Register New
agregar.content: This button takes you directly to the 'Register Order' form, since customers are registered when providing them a service.

tabla.title: Customer Directory
tabla.content: Shows the contact information for all your customers. Scroll to the right to see the available actions for each one.

acciones.title: Customer Actions
acciones.historial: Opens a window with the list of all orders this customer has placed over time.
acciones.editar: Allows modifying the name, phone, or address in case they have changed.

welcome.title: Cash Register Closing
welcome.content: This screen consolidates all income registered on a specific date, separated by payment method.

filtro.title: Select Date
filtro.content: It shows today's income by default. You can change the date to check the closing for previous days.

resumen.title: Summary and Printing
resumen.content: Shows the total operations of the day. The 'Print Closing' button will generate the summary ticket for your printer.

desglose.title: Breakdown by Method
desglose.content: Here you will see exactly how much money came in via Cash, Card, or Yape/Plin and the number of transactions.

total.title: Total Collected
total.content: It's the exact sum of all money received during that shift. Use it to balance your physical cash drawer.

welcome.title: Management Reports
welcome.content: Welcome to the analytics dashboard. Here you can see how your business is doing, which are your star services, and how your income evolves (Admins only).

filtros.title: Date Range
filtros.content: Select the period you want to analyze (default is the current month) and press 'Update' to recalculate the charts.

pie.title: Distribution by Service
pie.content: This pie chart shows you at a glance which types of service (Washing, Ironing, etc.) generate the most money.

resumen.title: General Summary
resumen.content: The large numbers show the total sum of income and the total amount of garments processed in the selected period.

barras.title: Daily Evolution
barras.content: A bar chart to help you identify which days you had income peaks and which days were slower.

tabla.title: Breakdown by Category
tabla.content: The exact numbers detailing how many garments and how much money was generated by each specific service.

welcome.title: Users and Roles
welcome.content: Here you control who has access to the system. You can create accounts for your team and assign them the appropriate role.

nuevo.title: New Employee
nuevo.content: When creating a new employee, you will define their username, password, and role (Cashier or Admin).

tabs.title: Status Filter
tabs.content: Use these buttons to toggle between Active employees currently using the system, and Inactive ones (history).

tabla.title: Staff Directory
tabla.content: View the status of each account and the role assigned to it within the system.

acciones.title: Access Control
acciones.clave: Allows you to assign a new secure password to the employee in case they forget it.
acciones.estado: Use this button to temporarily disable an employee's access if they no longer work with you, without deleting their history.

welcome.title: System Settings
welcome.content: The main control panel for your laundromat. Here you configure your company data and the prices for all your services.

datos.title: Business Data
datos.content: The information you put here (Name, Address, Phone) is what will be printed on all the tickets you give to customers.

tarifario.title: Catalog and Prices
tarifario.content: The complete list of garments you offer with their current prices. Changing a price here will only affect future orders.

nuevo.title: Add Service
nuevo.content: If you offer a new type of washing or a new garment, add it from this button so it appears in the menu when registering orders.

tabs.title: Active and Inactive Catalog
tabs.content: Toggle the view between the services you currently offer (Active) and those you have temporarily removed (Inactive).

acciones.title: Service Management
acciones.editar: Opens a window to update the current price of this garment.
acciones.estado: If you temporarily stop offering a service, you can disable it so it no longer appears when creating orders.
